name: Columbia Sportswear
outlook:
What Columbia Sportswear says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net salesNet sales are expected to increase 2.0 to 3.0 percent (prior 1.0 to 3.0 percent), resulting in net sales of $3.46 to $3.50 billion (prior $3.43 to $3.50 billion), compared to $3.40 billion in 2025. Foreign currency translation is expected to benefit net sales by approximately 50 to 70 basis points (prior 30 to 50 basis points).
  • Full year 2026: operating marginOperating margin is expected to be 8.7 to 9.1 percent of net sales (prior 8.5 to 9.3 percent), compared to operating margin of 6.1 percent of net sales in 2025.
  • Full year 2026: diluted earnings per shareDiluted earnings per share is expected to be $4.65 to $4.90 (prior $4.45 to $4.90), compared to $3.24 in 2025.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: net salesNet sales are expected to be $1,108 to $1,145 million, representing growth of 3.5 to 7.0 percent from $1,070 million for the comparable period in 2025. Net sales guidance includes the impact of a higher proportion of Fall 2026 shipments occurring in fourth quarter 2026 in comparison to the timing of Fall 2025 shipments last year.
  • Full year 2026: effective income tax rateEffective income tax rate is expected to be approximately 25.0 percent (unchanged).
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
